CASHCAT.public: Robinhood listed it in the app on Aug 6. That run already happened. https://coinsprobe.com/robinhood-lists-cashcat-memecoin-jumps-sharply-on-official-announcement/
CASHCAT.thesis: The chain's flagship cat already got the app listing. Tonight the flow can still look two-sided while mid-size money sells into a story everyone knows.
CASHCAT.opponent: Early winners distributing into people who still think the listing is news.
CASHCAT.kill: another heavy net-sell day shows up.

XST.public: Bubblemaps flagged a tight holder cluster plus TikTok clips. https://www.cryptopolitan.com/bubblemaps-xst-warning-on-tiktok/
XST.thesis: The flow can look like a reload. The float does not. Thin liquidity, a clustered supply warning, and several other coins use the same ticker.
XST.opponent: A clustered holder set can sell into mid-size flow that looks organic.
XST.kill: I wouldn't add while that supply warning is still the public story.

STONKBROKER.thesis: Not a naked ticker — broker NFTs that hold stock tokens, real site, real liquidity. The setup is not finished enough to chase.
STONKBROKER.opponent: Activation demand versus ordinary sellers — not a 99% buyer farm.
STONKBROKER.kill: liquidity collapses or the book starts looking like a farm.

HOOPLA.public: DexScreener has no website or socials for this contract. Web hits a different dead Base ticker, not 0x6713fdee.
HOOPLA.thesis: Same-day ticker with no website and no socials. The book looked like demand because almost every wallet was a buyer.
HOOPLA.opponent: Bundled inventory selling into first-day retail.
HOOPLA.kill: Already dead if the pool is empty.

$ROBBIE.public: Twitter @RobbieOnRH, no website. Web search for 0xe0eba1b7 finds other Robbie/ROBB/ROB contracts — not this one. https://x.com/RobbieOnRH
$ROBBIE.thesis: Same-day mascot ticker. A Twitter handle is not a story, and the main pool already printed thousands of percent. That is the crowd, not an early seat.
$ROBBIE.opponent: First-day retail chasing a brand-adjacent name.
$ROBBIE.kill: I wouldn't add into a same-day thousands-of-percent print.

COBRA.public: A landing page is not a ladder when almost every wallet is a net buyer.
COBRA.thesis: Farm-pack sibling. A site and a Twitter handle showed up. 99.8% of wallets are still net buyers.
COBRA.opponent: Farm wallets walking a ticker into late bids.
COBRA.kill: I wouldn't put risk on this.

DOGO.thesis: Listed as DogBull with a market cap. Mid-size buys and sells still print the same dollars.
DOGO.opponent: Circular mid flow, not a crowd.
DOGO.kill: I wouldn't put risk on this.

MOW.thesis: Same wash print as the other mid-size loop — buys and sells match, almost nobody trades twice.
MOW.kill: I wouldn't put risk on this.
